agent_response.hypothesis: a sudden spike in the rank of small-cap volume outliers on a given day is followed by a sharp decline in the next-day return ranks of those same stocks, suggesting a short-term reversal in liquidity-driven price dynamics.

factors.name: VRSZ
factors.explanation: This factor uses a z-score of the rank of volume z-scores over 20 days. It captures the abnormal volume days and their rank, then standardizes it to identify extreme outliers.

factors.name: VRCORR
factors.explanation: This factor measures the correlation between the rank of abnormal volume days and the rank of returns. It identifies stocks with extreme volume that follow a reversal in returns.

factors.name: VRR
factors.explanation: This factor calculates the z-score of the percentage change in the correlation between volume and return over 20 days. It captures the strength of the volume-return relationship before a reversal.
